page.notes: Printed text is clear apart from a few doubtful points. "Sese" is printed as such. The heading line "si-milia'ne" carries an apostrophe-like mark as printed. The line "disi-" in the heading reads "dissi-" with long s; the word may be "dis-" with a broken s. "patictur" is printed as such, probably a printing error for "patitur"; left as printed. The marginal reference "*p.7." is printed with a small mark before "p", read as a star. The large initial D is joined to "E hac" as "DE hac". Long s is written as plain s throughout.
